meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用HTML制作和渲染视频、动画与动态图形
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想用代码快速生成视频动画但不想用复杂软件
copy.tagline_en: Create and render videos, animations, and motion graphics with HTML
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate video animations with code without complex software

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会根据你的需求，把 HTML 文件转换成视频。它能处理宣传片、说明视频、字幕片段等多种视频类型，还能编辑或检查已有的 HyperFrames 项目。
howto.when: 当你要求制作、编辑、动画或渲染视频、动画或动态图形时触发。输入可以是网址、Figma 设计、文本等。默认使用 HyperFrames，除非你指定其他框架。

say.text: 帮我用这段 HTML 生成一个 10 秒产品宣传视频。
检查当前 HyperFrames 项目有没有更新。
say.note: Claude 会运行升级检查并告诉你结果。

say.text: 给这段采访视频加上字幕。
say.note: Claude 会进入嵌入式字幕工作流。

howto.what_en: The skill makes Claude render video from HTML compositions. It handles creating, editing, animating, or rendering videos like promos, explainers, captioned clips, and more. It also inspects and manages existing projects.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to make, create, edit, animate, or render any video, animation, or motion graphic. Inputs include URLs, Figma designs, text, etc. Defaults to HyperFrames unless another framework is explicitly chosen.

say_en.text: Generate a 10-second product promo video from this HTML.
say_en.note: Claude will start the HyperFrames workflow and produce the video.

say_en.text: Check for updates on the current HyperFrames project.
say_en.note: Claude runs an upgrade check and reports the result.

say_en.text: Add subtitles to this interview footage.
say_en.note: Claude will enter the embedded captions workflow.
